errors.evidence: The description claims that the categories are sub-sorted alphabetically by the second part of their name, but this is not true. The categories are sorted solely in descending order based on the harvested area for 2023.

errors.text_span: оранжевият стълб е по-дълъг от синия за всички зеленчуци, освен за картофи
errors.evidence: This statement claims that the 2023 harvest (orange bar) was larger than the 2022 harvest (blue bar) for all vegetables except potatoes. This is incorrect. The 2022 harvest was larger for tomatoes, pumpkins, strawberries, sweet corn, and green peas.
The orange bar for potatoes, representing the 2023 harvest, ends at approximately 7000 hectares, not "над" (over) 7000 hectares.
The phrase "реколтираните от открити площи площите" is repetitive and awkward. A clearer phrasing would be "реколтираните площи от открити площи" or simply "реколтираните открити площи".
